meta.title: Our scooter past a shop row, its own length as the ruler
meta.question: How fast is the scooter in m/s?
meta.notes: Field clip A14 from Set A (scooter), truth from a GPS app. The scooter's taped length is the prior. Faces at the shops, the rider and the number plates are blurred.

spec.notes: The moving scooter also serves as its own scale reference while crossing the foreground.

result.method: centroid; average speed along path; local quadratic window 0.30 s on detected frames only; scale from size/extent (longest); bootstrap B=500

checks.name: physical_bounds
checks.threshold: spec range [0, 20] and hard limits [0, 120] SI

audit.reason: Cyan outline consistently tracks the same moving scooter across all frames.

instances.target: instance 1 of 2: largest median mask area

guess.text: The scooter is moving at about 8 m/s.
